title: Kritt-ai/open-kritt
claim: Kritt-ai/open-kritt — Orchestrate AI agents to find real vulnerabilities in code.
why_good: Automating vulnerability detection with AI agents can significantly reduce the time and cost of security audits for companies.
value: Businesses in need of security compliance will pay for subscriptions or per-scan fees to access the service.
risk: If larger security firms integrate similar AI capabilities, they may overshadow this project, making it difficult to compete.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product for automating vulnerability detection, which companies would pay for.
